append.detail: CLOSED 2026-10-05: migration 20270345011700 adds reversal_refusals, reversal_lease_until, reversal_attempt_floor and the generated reversal_attempts_since_target to commerce_order_transfers (pgTAP cases added). reversalIdempotencyKey(row, from, to, refusals) carries the refusal count once Stripe has refused the row deterministically (isDeterministicStripeRefusal: the invalid_request_error family; a connection or API failure keeps the key). The claim is the compare-and-set on reversal_attempts plus a five-minute lease; raising the target moves reversal_attempt_floor instead of zeroing the counter, and the reconciler's ceiling reads attempts since the target. split-refund.test.ts: the Stripe fake now stores refusals under the key as Stripe does, and six new cases pin the retry after a saved refusal, the kept key after a network failure, the classifier, the fresh budget without a counter reset, two refunds in flight reversing one seller once, and the lease expiring for a dead worker. Not built here: the operator Send again door for reversals and the test-mode probe of a source_transaction transfer after an early partial refund (LIVE-234 fold-in), which the row listed as additions beyond the two defects.
